Data.scheme:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: EarthLink Plan Renewal REST API
  description: Real-time REST API for Subscriber Plan Renewals with Deduplication & SAP Integration
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: 'https://elcmqaap1.earthlink.iq:8010/pranav/v1'
paths:
  /plan/renew:
    post:
      summary: Renew subscriber plan with duplicate request interception
      operationId: renewPlan
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - TRANS_ID
                - SUB_ID
                - AMT
              properties:
                TRANS_ID:
                  type: string
                  example: 'TXN_99001'
                SUB_ID:
                  type: string
                  example: 'SUB_44012'
                AMT:
                  type: number
                  example: 45000.0
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Plan Renewal successfully processed and posted to SAP
        '409':
          description: Duplicate request intercepted by MediationZone Aggregation Profile
